12226-what-eight-million-women-want.title: What Eight Million Women Want
12226-what-eight-million-women-want.creator: Unknown
12226-what-eight-million-women-want.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. For the audacity of the title of this book I offer no apology. I have had it pointed out, not altogether facetiously, that it is impossible to determine with accuracy what one woman, much less what any number of women, wants. I sympathize with the first half of the tradition.

49935-bull-dog-drummond-the-adventures-o.title: Officer Who Found Peace Dull
49935-bull-dog-drummond-the-adventures-o.creator: "Sapper"
49935-bull-dog-drummond-the-adventures-o.description: A book by "Sapper". "It seems on the face of it a peculiar request from an unknown man," he remarked as she laid it down. "A dinner of four covers; no expense to be spared. Wines specified and if not in hotel to be obtained. A private room at half-past seven sharp. Guests to ask for room X."

arxiv-2301-02410.title: Codepod: A Namespace-Aware, Hierarchical Jupyter for Interactive Development at Scale Conference: ; Jan, 2023; Ames, IA, USA
arxiv-2301-02410.creator: Hebi Li, Forrest Sheng Bao, Qi Xiao, Jin Tian
arxiv-2301-02410.description: Abstract . Jupyter is a browser-based interactive development environment that has been popular recently. Jupyter models programs in code blocks, and makes it easy to develop code blocks interactively by running the code blocks and attaching rich media output. However, Jupyter provides no support for module systems and namespaces.

arxiv-2303-14271.creator: Toshiyasu Arai
arxiv-2303-14271.description: Abstract In this note we show through infinitary derivations that each provably well-founded strict partial order in ACA 0 {\rm ACA}_{0} admits an embedding to an ordinal < ε 0 <\varepsilon_{0} . 1 Provably well-founded relations A strict partial order \prec is an irreflexive \forall n(n\not\prec n) and transitive \forall n,m,k(n\prec m\prec k\to n\prec k) , relation on \omega .

arxiv-2306-05197.title: Time-Optimal Path Tracking with ISO Safety Guarantees
arxiv-2306-05197.creator: Shohei Fujii, Quang-Cuong Pham
arxiv-2306-05197.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shohei Fujii, Quang-Cuong Pham. One way of ensuring operator’s safety during human-robot collaboration is through Speed and Separation Monitoring (SSM), as defined in ISO standard ISO/TS 15066. In general, it is impossible to avoid all human-robot collisions: consider for instance the case when the robot does not move at all, a human operator can still collide with it by hitting it of her own voluntary motion.

arxiv-2307-08076.title: Diffusion to Confusion: Naturalistic Adversarial Patch Generation Based on Diffusion Model for Object Detector
arxiv-2307-08076.creator: Shuo-Yen Lin, Ernie Chu, Che-Hsien Lin, Jun-Cheng Chen, Jia-Ching Wang
arxiv-2307-08076.description: Abstract Many physical adversarial patch generation methods are widely proposed to protect personal privacy from malicious monitoring using object detectors. However, they usually fail to generate satisfactory patch images in terms of both stealthiness and attack performance without making huge efforts on careful hyperparameter tuning.

arxiv-2309-07376.title: VCD: A Video Conferencing Dataset for Video Compression
arxiv-2309-07376.creator: Babak Naderi, Ross Cutler, Nabakumar Singh Khongbantabam, Yasaman Hosseinkashi, Henrik Turbell, Albert Sadovnikov, Quan Zhou
arxiv-2309-07376.description: Abstract Commonly used datasets for evaluating video codecs are all very high quality and not representative of video typically used in video conferencing scenarios. We present the Video Conferencing Dataset (VCD) for evaluating video codecs for real-time communication, the first such dataset focused on video conferencing. VCD includes a wide variety of camera qualities and spatial and temporal information.

arxiv-2408-14918.description: Abstract . We describe an efficient iterative algorithm for the computation of theta functions of non-archimedean Schottky groups and, more generally, of (non-archimedean) discontinuous groups. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 14Q99, 14H42, 14K25, 11Y99 1. arxiv-2410-17534.title: OVT-B: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking
arxiv-2410-17534.creator: Haiji Liang, Ruize Han
arxiv-2410-17534.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary object perception has become an important topic in artificial intelligence, which aims to identify objects with novel classes that have not been seen during training. Under this setting, open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) in a single image has been studied in many literature.

arxiv-2503-16644.title: To impute or not to impute: How machine learning modelers treat missing data
arxiv-2503-16644.creator: Wanyi Chen, Mary Cummings
arxiv-2503-16644.description: Abstract Missing data is prevalent in tabular machine learning (ML) models, and different missing data treatment methods can significantly affect ML model training results. However, little is known about how ML researchers and engineers choose missing data treatment methods and what factors affect their choices. To this end, we conducted a survey of 70 ML researchers and engineers.

arxiv-2509-11179.title: Decomposing wave activity in the solar atmosphere
arxiv-2509-11179.creator: George Cherry, Boris Gudiksen, Adam J. Finley, Quentin Noraz
arxiv-2509-11179.description: Abstract Context. There remains much mystery about how or if wave-energy in the photosphere can be transferred sufficiently upwards through the solar atmosphere to contribute to coronal heating. In light of a plethora of theoretical and idealised studies, we must complement our understanding with realistic and self-driven simulations in order to confidently quantify such contributions. Aims.

pmc-10570771.title: Association of MMP1 gene polymorphisms with breast cancer risk: A narrative review
pmc-10570771.creator: Tahmina Akter, Md Abdul Aziz, Mohammad Safiqul Islam, Md Shahid Sarwar
pmc-10570771.description: Background and AimsBreast cancer is a multifactorial malignancy with different clinicopathological and molecular characteristics. It is the most frequent cancer in women in terms of both incidence and mortality. Matrix metallopeptidase 1 or MMP1 is a zinc‐dependent endopeptidase associated with several physiological processes through the modification of the extracellular matrix and tumor microenvironment.

pmc-11435891.title: Implications of Cross-Reactivity and Cross-Protection for Pneumococcal Vaccine Development
pmc-11435891.creator: Kristen Feemster, William P. Hausdorff, Natalie Banniettis, Heather Platt, Priscilla Velentgas, Alejandra Esteves-Jaramillo, Robert L. Burton, Moon H. Nahm, Ulrike K. Buchwald
pmc-11435891.description: Pneumococcal vaccines are a cornerstone for the prevention of pneumococcal diseases, reducing morbidity and mortality in children and adults worldwide. Pneumococcal vaccine composition is based on the polysaccharide capsule of Streptococcus pneumoniae, which is one of the most important identified contributors to the pathogen’s virulence.

pmc-11515601.title: Psychometric properties of the Chinese version of the nurses’ attitudes towards communication with the patient scale among Chinese nurses
pmc-11515601.creator: Meng Yue, Qiaoling Chen, Ying Liu, Rui Cheng, Dengfen Zeng
pmc-11515601.description: BackgroundNurses’ attitudes towards communication with patients influence the effectiveness of communication, which could reduce patients’ negative emotions and improve their adherence to medication and treatment. The aim of this study was to develop a Chinese version of the nurses’ attitudes towards communication with the patient (ACO) scale and examined its validity and reliability.

pmc-12798179.title: Screen time, sleep quality and mental health among adolescents of secondary schools in Dharan
pmc-12798179.creator: Isha Aryal, Vivek Gyawali, Nirmala Pradhan, Sami Lama, Kriti Thapa, Olumide Adeleke, Olumide Adeleke
pmc-12798179.description: Today’s generation children and adolescents are growing up with electronic media. Although the recommended screen time is up to two hours for adolescents, the screen exceeds the recommended limit. Excessive use of screen devices has resulted in decreased sleep and had a negative impact on mental health of adolescents.

pmc-13388470.title: Survival without major morbidity in extremely preterm infants: a prospective multicenter study in Shenzhen, China
pmc-13388470.creator: Yanping Guo, Ying Liu, Hua Peng, Songzhou Xu, Xudong Yan, Zhangbin Yu, Guobing Chen
pmc-13388470.description: BackgroundDue to regional and economic disparities, the current status of care for extremely preterm infants (EPIs) varies across mainland China and remains incompletely characterized. This study aimed to evaluate the survival rate and major morbidities of EPIs in Shenzhen and to identify factors associated with survival without major morbidity.

pmc-13668295.title: Hepatocyte senescence in metabolic dysfunction–associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD)
pmc-13668295.creator: Xinyue Pang, Nan Geng, Chenqi Lu, Qianwen Zhao, Junping Shi, Yali Xiong, Wenhao Li, Jie Li
pmc-13668295.description: Metabolic dysfunction–associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) has emerged as a major global health challenge, with particularly high morbidity and disease burden. Cellular senescence has been identified as one of the core mechanisms driving the onset and progression of MASLD. Hepatocytes, the primary functional cells of the liver, can undergo a senescent state under metabolic stress.
